  • Method Details

    • addAnnotation

      Annotation addAnnotation(String pageId, org.springframework.boot.configurationprocessor.json.JSONArray selectors, String motivation, String via) throws InterruptedException, NoSuchIndexEntryException, IOException, org.springframework.boot.configurationprocessor.json.JSONException
      Adds an annotation to the search index and the database.
      Parameters:
      pageId - ID of the page on which the annotation is located
      selectors - 1-n selectors (part of the target) of the annotation
      motivation - motivation of the annotation
      via - via field of annotation
      Returns:
      the added annotation
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - when the http request to database is interrupted
      NoSuchIndexEntryException - when there is no such page in the index
      IOException - when the http request to database was faulty and on connection error
      org.springframework.boot.configurationprocessor.json.JSONException - when server returns non success code or response payload does not contain annotation

    • getAnnotation

      Annotation getAnnotation(String annotationId) throws NoSuchIndexEntryException
      Gets an annotation from the searchIndexService by its ID.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      requested annotation
      Throws:
      NoSuchIndexEntryException - when there is no annotation like this in the index

    • updateAnnotation

      Annotation updateAnnotation(String annotationId, org.springframework.boot.configurationprocessor.json.JSONArray selectors, String motivation) throws NoSuchIndexEntryException, InterruptedException, IOException, org.springframework.boot.configurationprocessor.json.JSONException
      Updates an annotation in the search index and the database.
      Parameters:
      annotationId - ID of the annotation to update
      selectors - 1-n selectors (part of the target) of the annotation
      motivation - new motivation of the annotation
      Returns:
      updated annotation
      Throws:
      NoSuchIndexEntryException - when there is no such annotation in the index
      InterruptedException - when the http request to database is interrupted
      IOException - when the http request to database was faulty
      org.springframework.boot.configurationprocessor.json.JSONException - when there is a problem with the JSON object holding the selector
